description: This file defines the MixTaxonomyData class, which models taxonomy data related to financial classifications in the Fineract project. It includes constant values representing different taxonomy types, properties for taxonomy attributes, and a method to check if the taxonomy is of the 'portfolio' type.

classes.name: MixTaxonomyData
classes.description: A data class representing taxonomy information in the Fineract system, with properties for id, name, namespace, dimension, type, and description, along with constants for type classifications and a method to identify portfolio types.

methods.name: isPortfolio
methods.description: Checks if the taxonomy data's type corresponds to the 'portfolio' classification.
